title: Dopemux Autoreview Platform — complete the governed lane, govern the merge engine, ship as a dopemux feature
description: Delta series over the shipped DMX-EMBEDDED-AUDIT-PR-CLEANUP-RECONCILED (#718). Track A completes the check-only governance lane (PAL-clink live verdict, Action Bridge CLI, Copilot renderer, independent embedded-audit CI workflow, end-to-end loop, CI/branch-protection reliability). Track B subordinates the autonomous src/dopemux_pr_merge_specialist engine to PR Steward via a fail-closed steward_gate (remediation vs finalization split, expectedHeadOid merge, governed_automerge default OFF). Track C ships the feature into every `dopemux init` repo (importable engine + `dopemux pr-steward` console command + minimal scaffolding + doctor skew-check). Track D is a final adversarial hardening pass.
